output.review_comment: All code changes are correct and necessary to pass the test suite. The tiebreaker logic was appropriately changed from (quotient, larger_headcount) to (quotient, smaller_headcount) to match the spec as encoded in the tests, which the teammate confirmed are authoritative. The docstring update is justified since it corrects the documentation to match the actual specification. All nine tests should pass. Minor note: The PR description could be more confident about the docstring change rather than expressing doubt—the teammate was clear that the tests encode the agreed spec, so the original docstring was simply incorrect.
